meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: Drives the GUI of a visible local app window through `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, typing, menus, dialogs, and screenshots in native apps and external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari) or webviews. Prefer a programmatic path (shell, filesystem, git, HTTP, existing CLIs) whenever it can complete the task. Use only when a visible window needs GUI control those cannot reach. Do not use for Orca's embedded browser (`orca-cli`).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让程序替你操作桌面窗口,自动点击、输入、读菜单并截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果某个软件只有界面没有接口,却还要一遍遍手动操作它。
copy.tagline_en: Drive a desktop window for you: click, type, read menus, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if an app only offers a UI and you keep operating it by hand.

howto.what: 通过 `orca computer` 驱动本机可见窗口的图形界面：读取无障碍树、点击、输入、菜单、对话框、截图，覆盖原生应用与外部浏览器窗口。任务能用命令行、文件系统、git、HTTP 等程序化方式完成时，优先走程序化路径。
howto.when: 当某个可见窗口需要图形界面操作、而 shell、文件系统、git、HTTP 或已有 CLI 等程序化方式无法完成时使用；Orca 内嵌浏览器（`orca-cli`）不适用。

say.text: 用 computer-use 打开 Chrome 的设置页并截图
say.note: 会先加载版本匹配的指南再执行

say.text: 在这个桌面应用的对话框里填好内容并保存
say.note: 操作的是当前可见窗口

say.text: 用 orca computer 读取当前窗口的无障碍树
say.note: 需先解析出本次会话的 ORCA 可执行文件

howto.what_en: Drives the GUI of a visible local app window via `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, typing, menus, dialogs and screenshots, in native apps and external browser windows. Prefers a programmatic path when it can finish the task.
howto.when_en: Use when a visible window needs GUI control that shell, filesystem, git, HTTP or existing CLIs cannot reach. Not for Orca's embedded browser (`orca-cli`).

say_en.text: Use computer-use to open Chrome settings and take a screenshot
Fill in this dialog in the desktop app and save it
say_en.note: Acts on the visible window's GUI
